giga.menu.debug.true=Debug
giga.menu.debug.true.build.zsk_args.debug=-debug

giga.menu.link_mode.dynamic=Dynamic
giga.menu.link_mode.static=Static
giga.menu.link_mode.static.build.link_mode=static
giga.menu.link_mode.static.upload.extension=bin-zsk.bin

giga.build.zephyr_target=arduino_giga_r1//m7
giga.build.zephyr_args=--shield arduino_giga_display_shield
giga.build.zephyr_hals=hal_stm32 hal_infineon
giga.build.variant=arduino_giga_r1_stm32h747xx_m7
giga.build.artifact=zephyr_main

giga.build.extra_flags=
giga.build.postbuild.cmd="{tools.imgtool.path}/{tools.imgtool.cmd}" exit
giga.build.board=GIGA

giga.pid.0=0x0066
giga.upload_port.0.vid=0x2341
giga.upload_port.0.pid=0x0066

giga.upload.tool=dfu-util
giga.upload.tool.default=dfu-util
giga.upload.protocol=

giga.upload.vid=0x2341
giga.upload.pid=0x0366
giga.upload.interface=0
giga.upload.use_1200bps_touch=true
giga.upload.wait_for_upload_port=true
giga.upload.native_usb=true

giga.bootloader.tool=dfu-util
giga.bootloader.tool.default=dfu-util

giga.bootloader.pid=0x0366

giga.bootloader.address=0x08040000

opta.debug.svd_file={runtime.platform.path}/svd/STM32H747_CM7.svd

# PiZZA -- Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (BCM2710A1, Cortex-A53, aarch64).
# Out-of-tree variant. Sketches load as llext from a FAT file on the
# SD card; the "loader" firmware is the kernel image written to the
# SD boot partition. See notes/pizza-arduino-phase0.md.
pizza.name=PiZZA (Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W)
pizza.build.core=arduino
pizza.build.crossprefix=aarch64-zephyr-elf-
# Until the aarch64-zephyr-elf toolchain ships as an Arduino-packaged tool,
# the developer needs a symlink at
#   ~/Library/Arduino15/packages/arduino-git/tools/aarch64-zephyr-elf/0.17.0
# pointing to their local Zephyr SDK (`~/zephyr-sdk/aarch64-zephyr-elf`).
pizza.build.compiler_path={runtime.tools.aarch64-zephyr-elf-0.17.0.path}/bin/

# Override platform.txt's link_command to drop --specs=nano.specs /nosys.specs:
# the aarch64-zephyr-elf toolchain ships picolibc (not newlib-nano), so those
# spec files don't exist. The relocatable-ELF link doesn't need picolibc.specs
# either -- nothing needs the startup-file or syscall stubs at link time.
pizza.build.link_command="{compiler.path}{compiler.c.elf.cmd}" "-L{build.path}" "-L{build.variant.path}" {compiler.c.elf.flags} {compiler.c.elf.extra_flags} {build.extra_flags} {build.extra_ldflags} {compiler.zephyr.common_ldflags} {compiler.ldflags} {object_files} -Wl,--start-group "{build.path}/{archive_file}" {compiler.zephyr.extra_ldflags} {compiler.libraries.ldflags} -Wl,--end-group {build.link_args.{build.link_mode}}

pizza.build.zephyr_target=rpi_zero_2w/bcm2710
pizza.build.zephyr_args=-DTOOLCHAIN_HAS_GLIBCXX=ON
pizza.build.zephyr_hals=hal_broadcom
pizza.build.variant=rpi_zero_2w_bcm2710
pizza.build.artifact=pizza
pizza.build.board=PIZZA
pizza.build.zephyr_toolchain=aarch64-zephyr-elf

# IDE machine fields -- previously emitted into the auto-generated boards.local.txt
# at package time; kept in source so they survive dist-build (which regenerates
# boards.local.txt header-only). mcu = IDE display/recipe hint; maximum_data_size
# = the IDE RAM-usage cap (1 MiB, the loader's llext heap).
pizza.build.mcu=cortex-a53
pizza.upload.maximum_data_size=1048576

# No USB DFU on this target -- the Pi boots from SD. The sketch is the raw
# relocatable ELF (not the upstream Arduino header-wrapped variant), since
# the PiZZA loader's fs_loader path consumes a stock ELF/llext file directly.
pizza.upload.extension=elf

# Skip the zephyr-sketch-tool header-wrap hooks -- the relocatable ELF
# produced by the linker IS our final .llext, no header needed.
pizza.recipe.hooks.objcopy.postobjcopy.1.pattern=
pizza.recipe.hooks.objcopy.postobjcopy.2.pattern=

# Skip the zephyr-check-size step -- PiZZA sketches live on SD-FAT with no
# fixed flash-partition size limit. (The default tool reads bounds from a
# .config file we'd otherwise have to maintain.)
pizza.recipe.size.pattern=

# Skip the gen-rodata-ld multi-pass rodata split. That tool exists to feed
# CONFIG_LLEXT_RODATA_NO_RELOC=y, which we explicitly disable on aarch64+MMU
# in the variant .conf. Replace the second-pass link with one that drops
# the rodata_split.ld dependency.
pizza.recipe.c.combine.3.pattern=
pizza.recipe.c.combine.4.pattern={build.link_command} {build.link_args.build-{build.link_mode}} {build.link_args.build-common}

# Two upload methods, selectable via Tools -> Upload method:
#
#   "USB (CDC)"      [default] -- single-cable upload to the running loader.
#                    The cdcupload tool does the 1200-bps touch itself and
#                    streams the sketch over CDC; the loader swaps it
#                    in-process (no reboot, no card swap). See platform.txt
#                    tools.cdcupload + tools/cdc-upload/cdc-upload.py.
#   "SD card reader" -- legacy flow: copy the .llext onto the FAT partition
#                    mounted at /Volumes/RECOVERY (PINN convention) and eject;
#                    for headless / no-USB-host use.
#
# Base defaults mirror the USB (CDC) method so an un-changed menu still does
# the single-cable upload; the sdfat mount paths stay defined for the SD
# method to pick up.
pizza.upload.protocol=
pizza.upload.transport=
pizza.upload.tool=cdcupload
pizza.upload.tool.default=cdcupload
pizza.upload.native_usb=true
pizza.upload.use_1200bps_touch=false
pizza.upload.wait_for_upload_port=false
pizza.upload.sdfat.mount=/Volumes/RECOVERY
pizza.upload.sdfat.mount.macosx=/Volumes/RECOVERY
pizza.upload.sdfat.mount.linux=/media/{user}/RECOVERY
pizza.upload.sdfat.mount.windows=E:

pizza.menu.upload_method.usbcdc=USB (CDC)
pizza.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.tool=cdcupload
pizza.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.tool.default=cdcupload
pizza.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.native_usb=true
pizza.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.use_1200bps_touch=false
pizza.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.wait_for_upload_port=false

pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader=SD card reader
pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader.upload.tool=sdfat
pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader.upload.tool.default=sdfat
pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader.upload.native_usb=false
pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader.upload.use_1200bps_touch=false
pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader.upload.wait_for_upload_port=false
pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader.upload.sdfat.mount=/Volumes/RECOVERY
pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader.upload.sdfat.mount.macosx=/Volumes/RECOVERY
pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader.upload.sdfat.mount.linux=/media/{user}/RECOVERY
pizza.menu.upload_method.sdreader.upload.sdfat.mount.windows=E:

##############################################################################################################

# PiZZa -- Raspberry Pi Zero W (BCM2835, ARM1176JZF-S, ARMv6KZ, AArch32).
# v1 scope is Blink + USB-CDC Serial. WiFi/SPI/I2C/SD-driver bring-up is
# tracked separately; the variant .conf bakes the SD-FAT config in so the
# loader's auto-load path picks up /SD:/sketch.llext as soon as the BCM2835
# SDHost driver enumerates.
pizza_zero_w.name=PiZZa (Raspberry Pi Zero W)
pizza_zero_w.build.core=arduino
pizza_zero_w.build.crossprefix=arm-zephyr-eabi-
# Until the arm-zephyr-eabi toolchain ships as an Arduino-packaged tool,
# the developer needs a symlink at
#   ~/Library/Arduino15/packages/arduino-git/tools/arm-zephyr-eabi/0.17.0
# pointing to their local Zephyr SDK (`~/zephyr-sdk-1.0.1/gnu/arm-zephyr-eabi`).
pizza_zero_w.build.compiler_path={runtime.tools.arm-zephyr-eabi-0.17.0.path}/bin/

# Override platform.txt's link_command to drop --specs=nano.specs /nosys.specs:
# the arm-zephyr-eabi toolchain ships picolibc (not newlib-nano), so those
# spec files don't exist. The relocatable-ELF link doesn't need picolibc.specs
# either -- nothing needs the startup-file or syscall stubs at link time.
pizza_zero_w.build.link_command="{compiler.path}{compiler.c.elf.cmd}" "-L{build.path}" "-L{build.variant.path}" {compiler.c.elf.flags} {compiler.c.elf.extra_flags} {build.extra_flags} {build.extra_ldflags} {compiler.zephyr.common_ldflags} {compiler.ldflags} {object_files} -Wl,--start-group "{build.path}/{archive_file}" {compiler.zephyr.extra_ldflags} {compiler.libraries.ldflags} -Wl,--end-group {build.link_args.{build.link_mode}}

pizza_zero_w.build.zephyr_target=rpi_zero_w/bcm2835
pizza_zero_w.build.zephyr_args=-DTOOLCHAIN_HAS_GLIBCXX=ON
pizza_zero_w.build.zephyr_hals=hal_broadcom

pizza_zero_w.build.artifact=pizza

pizza_zero_w.build.zephyr_toolchain=arm-zephyr-eabi

# IDE machine fields -- previously emitted into the auto-generated boards.local.txt
# at package time; kept in source so they survive dist-build.
pizza_zero_w.build.mcu=arm1176jzf-s
pizza_zero_w.upload.maximum_data_size=1048576

# No USB DFU on this target -- the Pi boots from SD. The sketch is the raw
# relocatable ELF.
pizza_zero_w.upload.extension=elf

# Skip the zephyr-sketch-tool header-wrap hooks.
pizza_zero_w.recipe.hooks.objcopy.postobjcopy.1.pattern=
pizza_zero_w.recipe.hooks.objcopy.postobjcopy.2.pattern=

# Skip the zephyr-check-size step.
pizza_zero_w.recipe.size.pattern=

# Skip the gen-rodata-ld multi-pass rodata split. CONFIG_LLEXT_RODATA_NO_RELOC=n
# in the variant .conf (VMSAv6 MMU is always on); replace the second-pass link.
pizza_zero_w.recipe.c.combine.3.pattern=
pizza_zero_w.recipe.c.combine.4.pattern={build.link_command} {build.link_args.build-{build.link_mode}} {build.link_args.build-common}

# Two upload methods, selectable via Tools -> Upload method:
#
#   "USB (CDC)"      [default] -- single-cable upload to the running loader.
#                    The cdcupload tool does the 1200-bps touch itself and
#                    streams the sketch over CDC; the loader writes
#                    /SD:/sketch.llext and sys_reboot()s. See platform.txt
#                    tools.cdcupload + tools/cdc-upload/cdc-upload.py.
#   "SD card reader" -- legacy flow: copy the .llext onto the FAT partition
#                    mounted at /Volumes/RECOVERY (PINN convention) and eject;
#                    for headless / no-USB-host use.
pizza_zero_w.upload.protocol=
pizza_zero_w.upload.transport=
pizza_zero_w.upload.tool=cdcupload

pizza_zero_w.upload.native_usb=true
pizza_zero_w.upload.use_1200bps_touch=false
pizza_zero_w.upload.wait_for_upload_port=false
pizza_zero_w.upload.sdfat.mount=/Volumes/RECOVERY
pizza_zero_w.upload.sdfat.mount.macosx=/Volumes/RECOVERY
pizza_zero_w.upload.sdfat.mount.linux=/media/{user}/RECOVERY
pizza_zero_w.upload.sdfat.mount.windows=E:

pizza_zero_w.menu.upload_method.usbcdc=USB (CDC)
pizza_zero_w.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.tool=cdcupload
pizza_zero_w.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.tool.default=cdcupload
pizza_zero_w.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.native_usb=true
pizza_zero_w.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.use_1200bps_touch=false
pizza_zero_w.menu.upload_method.usbcdc.upload.wait_for_upload_port=false

pizza_zero_w.menu.upload_method.sdreader=SD card reader
